title: GiftCompass Product (Catalog Item)
description: One buyable gift candidate in the GiftCompass catalog. Field names match the column names of data/products_demo.csv exactly, so the CSV is a flat serialisation of this schema (array fields are pipe-separated in the CSV).

tags.description: Free-text descriptors for embedding and keyword match. CSV: pipe-separated.

interest_keys.description: Keys from interest-taxonomy.json. This is the join to Persona.interests[].key. CSV: pipe-separated.

price_sar.description: Indicative price in Saudi Riyal, delivery excluded.

budget_band.description: Derived from price_sar. Matches the sender's budget selector.

relationship_fit.description: Hard filter, not a score. A gift that is right for a partner can be wrong for a colleague. CSV: pipe-separated.

giftability.description: How well this item works AS A GIFT (presentable, not too personal a size/fit, does not require the giver to know a private detail). A cheap phone case scores low even for a phone lover.

embarrassment_risk.description: P2 embarrassment metric. Risk that the item lands as a faux pas. Thresholded per relationship at filter time: colleague 0.20, relative 0.30, friend/family 0.45, partner 0.70.

novelty.description: Inverse of how obvious/common the item is. Feeds the 'pleasant surprise' term in ranking.

personalizable.description: Can be engraved/customised. Raises sentimental value.

requires_size.description: Clothing/rings. Filtered out unless the sender declares they know the size.

available_in_jeddah.description: In stock for Jeddah delivery or collection.

delivery_days.description: Typical days to Jeddah. Hard-filtered against days_until_occasion.

retailer_hint.description: Indicative retailer TYPE or name for sourcing, e.g. 'Jarir', 'Noon', 'local roastery'. In demo data this is a sourcing hint, NOT a verified listing.

product_url.description: Deep link to the seller. NULL in demo data - never fabricate a URL.

data_status.description: 'demo' = placeholder item written for prototype development: the item type and price band are realistic for Jeddah, but the price is not a quoted price and no listing has been checked. 'verified' = sourced from a real listing on a stated date. Only 'verified' rows may ever be shown to a real user.
